analysis.title: Gen Z Purchase Behavior: Key Insights from Statista Data
analysis.summary:
Regarding the purchasing behavior of Gen Z, the available Statista data presents the following picture:

Digital impulses have a particularly strong influence on purchasing decisions: Influencer posts influenced 57% of Gen Z in the USA in 2025, and posts from brands they already follow motivated 54% to purchase a product or service. In the fashion context, product experience also plays an important role: 51% of Gen Z in the USA stated in 2025 that trying on clothing before purchase is essential. When it comes to brands, the available data shows a strong beauty orientation: in 2025, The Ordinary was the most popular brand among Gen Z in the USA, and beauty brands dominated the brands that are disproportionately popular with Gen Z. At the same time, there is evidence of brand loyalty: two out of five Gen Z consumers in the USA stated in 2025 that they have a favorite brand they shop from. For context: The Statista data used here refers to the USA. It is also noteworthy that there is a time discrepancy in one source: the source was published on October 17, 2024, but refers to a value for 2025. Based on general knowledge (not from Statista data): such statements should be interpreted more as forward-looking.

key_insights.insight: Digital channels are the primary drivers of Gen Z purchase decisions.
